Network Title: Manitoba – Manitoba Agriculture, Weather Program

Domain: Weather

Network Type: Atmospheric: Surface

Network Provider: Manitoba Agriculture

Network Provider Website: https://www.gov.mb.ca/agriculture/

Station Automation: Automated

Highest Sampling Frequency:
15 min May-November
60 min November - April

Data Feed Frequency: Real time

Period of Operation (Seasonal or Continuous): Continuous

Number of Stations: 120

Category of Reported Elements: Temperature; Humidity; Rainfall; Wind; Radiation; Soil; Dew point; Total precipitation; Pressure

Data Access Points: https://www.gov.mb.ca/agriculture/weather/

Quality Assessed (Yes/No): No (minimal)

Legal Constraints: This is raw data that has undergone minimal quality control. There may be missing or erroneous data as a result of sensor malfunction, or routine maintenance. Use data at your own risk.
